prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Concentric black and white rings ripple outward from the cake across the whole frame, bending the real picture like ripples on a pond, with one thin spiral of red running through them. Camera low behind a tiered cake on a silver tray, the frame tilted. A tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, backed against a furnace, holds the tray out with trembling hands, a sickly smile; the crowd fills the room around him, tommy guns lying abandoned on the floor. Light: the furnace behind him; the crowd's lanterns. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
